title: UF H&E Staining
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beamjac6
materials: Prepare staining line with reagents in order of use, based on steps three through 25. Example of a H&E stain line.
Prepare staining line with reagents in order of use, based on steps three through 25. Example of a H&E stain line.

steps.title: Prepare Slides
steps.instruction: Place slides into a xylene compatible slide rack.

steps.title: Deparaffinize with Xylene
steps.instruction: Immerse the slide holder in two sequential xylene staining stations.

substeps.instruction: Immerse in the first xylene staining station for 5 minutes.
Immerse in the second xylene staining station for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Gradually rehydrate the slides through a series of ethanol and water washes.

substeps.instruction: Quickly blot excess xylene from the rack and transfer to the first 100% EtOH station for 5 minutes.
Transfer to the second 100% EtOH station for 5 minutes.
Transfer to 95% EtOH for 3 minutes.
Transfer to 70% EtOH for 3 minutes.
Transfer to 50% EtOH for 3 minutes.
Transfer to water for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a second change of water for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Hematoxylin Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the slides with Hematoxylin and rinse.

substeps.instruction: Quickly blot excess water from the slide holder.
Transfer slides to Hematoxylin for 1 minute and 15 seconds.
Rinse in de-ionized water.
Transfer slides to tap water for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Blue and Clarify
steps.instruction: Process slides through water, clarifier, and bluing reagent.

substeps.instruction: Place slide rack back into de-ionized water for 1 minute.
Transfer to a second water staining dish for 1 minute.
Transfer to Aqueous Clarifier for 45 seconds.
Perform a quick rinse in de-ionized water.
Transfer to tap water for 1 minute.
Transfer to bluing reagent for 1 minute.

steps.title: Perform Eosin-Y Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the slides with Eosin-Y after preliminary dehydration.

substeps.instruction: Place in water for 5 minutes.
Transfer to 80% EtOH for 1 minute.
Transfer to Eosin-Y for 1 minute.

steps.title: Dehydrate and Clear
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the slides and clear them using ethanol and xylene.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to 100% EtOH for 2 minutes.
Transfer to a second 100% EtOH station for 5 minutes.
Blot excess ethanol from the rack.
Transfer to xylene for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a fresh xylene station for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mount Coverslips
steps.instruction: Affix a coverslip to the slide using a xylene compatible mountant.
